purpose: Read-only feasibility review of MemoryArena for memory relation and utility experiments
allowed_checks: Pinned public JSONL download; schema, counts, identities and shared-background grouping
Read public setup, memory injection, agent history and scorer implementation
CPU-only offline scorer probes and prompt capture with a fake model
Read-only access checks and size inventories for external assets
content_review_scope: First travel group and first shopping sequence may be inspected for protocol feasibility; treat those groups as exposed discovery cases. Other rows are used for structural counts and hashes only.
prohibited_in_this_review: Real model, embedding or LLM judge requests
External user messages or upstream repository writes
Treating offline diagnostic scores as memory utility measurements
large_assets: Inventory only; do not download the multi-GB product or search corpus for this review
